title: Coefficientwise support-map isomorphism after scalar restriction
statement: Under an ambient support adjunction, each component of the exceptional finite-support extension map becomes an isomorphism after applying target scalar restriction and the intrinsic realization inverse.

source.place: Tag 0GL6, proper/open mate calculation and coefficient generation

proof.text: Use arrow normalization to identify the restricted component with constant-coefficient projection, apply the projection theorem, and use conservativity of scalar restriction.

proof_origin: Strictly componentwise intermediate result used by final natural-isomorphism proof.

lean.statement: theorem exceptionalFiniteSupportExtensionMap_component_after_restriction_isIso {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) {G : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A ⥤ proEtaleDerivedCategory X A} (_a : sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate A c ⊣ G) (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) : IsIso (((proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).inverse).map ((exceptionalFiniteSupportExtensionMap φ c).app ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).functor.obj K)))
